_instruction: Myanmar FDA — P 7 Stability report * (one PDF). Include Zone IVB remark when applicable.

components.title: Stability report
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Stability report demonstrating product stability through proposed shelf life *. CONTRACT: Summarize accelerated and long-term results, proposed shelf life and storage conditions. REMARK (when Zone IVB applies): Accelerated at 40°C ± 2°C / 75% ± 5% RH for 6 months; real-time at 30°C ± 2°C / 75% ± 5% RH for proposed shelf life.

components.title: Stability data summary
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Key stability results table from source (time point × test).
